violations.why: closer2_isr writes 42 then re-reads it. An equal-priority closer ISR can preempt in between and reset it to 0 through i8xx_tco_write.
closer3_isr writes 42 then checks it. Another closer ISR running i8xx_tco_write can write 0 in between.
JudgeCondi in closer2_isr reads var1 twice. The higher-priority writer1_isr can write it between the two reads.
JudgeCondi reads var2 twice. The higher-priority writer2_isr can write it between the two reads.
var3++ in closer3_isr is a non-atomic read-modify-write. The higher-priority writer3_isr can preempt it, and its write is then lost.
